node.value: More quality-of-life hacks are available on NexusMods, listed as 'CE hacks'. Includes low platforms, cooking helper, faster material storage, map re-draw, camera control.
More quality-of-life hacks are available on NexusMods, listed as 'Android hacks'. Currently only includes faster material storage.
You can enable mods and view their details in the Options menu.
Click the mod title in the Options menu to view a brief description of the mod's functionality.
Check the Changelog to discover what is new and updated in the mods.
Need help or have a new idea? Join the official 10tons discord server to chat about mods.
Game too easy? Want more challenge? Adjust the difficulty when starting a new game. Difficulty affects enemy health, speed, damage, XP.
Click a POI on the map or in the collection menu to see more information. This includes towers, fishing spots, obelisks, teleporters, the Ark.
Wiki articles are available on many screens, click the round wiki icon to open a browser link. For quests, bosses, creatures, tools, specials, trinkets, features, skills, materials, dishes, etc.
Got an endgame weapon to carry into a new game but don't want to unlock Ark level 3 again? New Game Plus can be started anytime at your home shelter.
Bring your most powerful weapons and inventions into New Game Plus. You can select which tools or features you want to keep.
You can start a new game from the shelters scattered across the main island. Some shelters offer a tougher start, others are just for fun.
Start a new game where trees, bushes, rocks are protected from your attacks. Let the island show its beauty, with nature left untouched.
